title: feat(web): link infra pages to their source

summaries.body:

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
Contained to the web shell plus additive `sourceId` columns, but the wiring has no test and the author has not run it in an app.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Adds a Source button to infra pages: integration pages resolve by platform, detail pages by the stamped `src_` id, and five summary queries gain `sourceId`. Additive and web-contained, so safe to merge; the open `McpQueryError` issues in `page/registry.ts` are untouched.

- `definePage` pages declare an optional `source` ref the shell renders in the top bar
- Five detail summary queries return `sourceId` via `argMax(maple_source_id, TimeUnix)`
- Shell reads the org's sources once per entry of a source-linked page

### Before merge

- [ ] **Manual** · Get the failing `Tests (small-3)` check green on the head commit <!-- ms:manual:get-the-failing-tests-small-3-check-green-on-the-head-commit -->
